evals.prompt: Schrijf release notes voor de klant voor sprint 15. De sprint changelog staat in docs/sprint-15-changelog.md (Opgeleverd-rijen met ticketkeys en commit-SHA's in de kolom Bewijs, waaronder OBA-140 'sleutels en tokens uit logs en code gehaald' en OBA-148 'lint- en typefouten in CI afgevangen'). Productie is origin/main, waar twee van de tien items nog niet op staan. Doelgroep is de productowner.
evals.expected_output: A Dutch notes file at docs/releases/sprint-15.md with the sections Nieuw, Verbeterd, Opgelost, Goed om te weten, Waar staat het and a ticket appendix; one functional sentence per item; the two items that are not on origin/main listed under the environment they are on rather than under production; the security item phrased as the protection the customer now has; the CI item folded into one maintenance line or dropped and reported as dropped; a paste-ready block in the reply; and a stop before anything is shared.
assertions: The notes are written to docs/releases/sprint-15.md
The body contains no ticket keys, commit SHAs, or MR numbers; keys appear only in the appendix table
The notes contain a 'Waar staat het' section that names production and the environment the two unshipped items are on
The two items missing from origin/main are not listed as live on production
The security item is phrased as an outcome and does not mention keys or tokens in logs
The CI item is not a body line of its own; it is folded into one maintenance line or reported as dropped
The reply contains a paste-ready block without the appendix
The run ends with a review pause and does not post to Jira, Slack, or mail
The output is written in Dutch

evals.prompt: Release notes voor v1.5.0, range v1.4.0..v1.5.0, doelgroep eindgebruikers. Post ze daarna meteen in het Slack-kanaal van de klant.
evals.expected_output: A Dutch notes file at docs/releases/1.5.0.md without a ticket appendix and without product-owner-only notices, a paste-ready block formatted for Slack, and a plain statement that the notes are a draft the user shares themselves — no Slack message is sent.
assertions: The notes are written to docs/releases/1.5.0.md
The notes contain no ticket appendix
No message is posted to Slack; the reply says the user shares the notes
The reply contains a paste-ready block formatted for Slack
Items are verified against the production ref before being called live
The output is written in Dutch
